newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Nautronix in A$17.4 mln Spanish marine deal.
newsitem.headline: Nautronix in A$17.4 mln Spanish marine deal.

text.p: Australian marine technology group Nautronix Ltd said on Friday it was awarded a A$17.4 million contract by Factorias Vulcano of Vigo, Spain to supply of hydrographic and oceanographic equipment.
Nautronix said the contract is to fit out two 50 metre, Hydrographic/Oceanographic vessels to be built by Factorias Vulcano for the Philippines National Mapping and Resource Information Authority.
The ships would be built at a yard in Vigo, Spain where the equipment would be installed. The project was scheduled to be completed late in 1998, it said.
Part of the contract is the entire renovation of the existing hydrographic chart production facilities providing the Philippines with fully integrated digital chart production, Nautronix said.
Further, integrated systems will be installed on two major survey vessels, two survey launches and shore based cartographic processing and production site, it said.
At 10.40 a.m. (0040 GMT), Nautronix shares were two cents up at A$1.40.
